desc.zh: 按截止日安排课程，用最长课程替换挽回时间。
desc.en: Order courses by deadline and recover time by removing the longest.

complexity: O(n log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Deadline ordering
concepts.description: Exchange adjacent inverted deadlines without losing feasibility.

concepts.name: Longest-course removal
concepts.description: Repair the first overload while preserving an optimal possible count.

concepts.name: Max heap
concepts.description: Negated durations expose the longest retained course.
